rls_policies.with_check:
((get_auth_role() = 'INSTRUCTOR'::text) AND (exam_id IN ( SELECT e.id
   FROM (exams e
     JOIN course_instructors ci ON ((ci.course_id = e.course_id)))
  WHERE (ci.instructor_profile_id = auth.uid()))))

rls_policies.qual:
((exam_id IN ( SELECT exams.id
   FROM exams
  WHERE (((exams.status)::text = 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR (exams.course_id IN ( SELECT course_instructors.course_id
           FROM course_instructors
          WHERE (course_instructors.instructor_profile_id = auth.uid())))))) OR (get_auth_role() = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPORT_STAFF'::text, 'ACADEMIC_ADMINISTRATOR'::text, 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR'::text])))

(((status)::text = 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR (course_id IN ( SELECT course_instructors.course_id
   FROM course_instructors
  WHERE (course_instructors.instructor_profile_id = auth.uid()))) OR (get_auth_role() = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPORT_STAFF'::text, 'ACADEMIC_ADMINISTRATOR'::text, 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR'::text])))
((id = auth.uid()) OR (get_auth_role() = ANY (ARRAY['ACADEMIC_ADMINISTRATOR'::text, 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR'::text])) OR (auth.uid() IS NULL))
